title: Robyn Debuts AI Platform for Creating Custom Personal Productivity Agents
summary:
The startup behind Robyn has opened registration for its new personal agentic platform that allows users to deploy networks of AI assistants to manage professional and daily tasks. Accessible via the web or text, the tool connects with external applications and can deliver scheduled updates through iMessage, with founder Jenny Shao stating the service can save users 20 hours per week.

The platform is currently limited to 1,000 people via an invite-only system and competes with existing AI productivity tools like Muse and Instinct. Shao, who developed the system using research on human memory from Nobel laureate Eric Kandel, says the tool requires no setup and can respond to a single-sentence request.
